artworks.publicDescription: A scarlet creature with a three-tined fork and flames appears above a lamb and cross. The 1928 guide calls the scene Sin and Salvation: the devil represents sin, while the lamb and cross represent Christ and salvation.

evidence.section: The upper grotesque creature holds a three-tined fork amid flames; below, an animal stands beside a cross-marked round/book-like emblem and three hanging balls. These support the two guide motifs, but do not establish their original arrangement.
